module: Flowgraph node "Spawn TSStatic" (once_instant, author BeamNG). Creates a TSStatic object with shapeName, position, rotation and scale. Inputs: flow, reset, shapeName, position, rotation, scale. Outputs: flow, created (one-frame impulse), lastId. The object is deleted on stop, at the end of the mission or on destruction.
notes: The code for an offset (pin offset) is commented out in createObject and has no effect.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Initializes the object list and data.maxObjectCount = 1.

createObject.desc: Creates the TSStatic (canSave = false), registers it under spawnedObj_<time>_<id>_<n>, writes lastId and notifies the editor.

workOnce.desc: Creates the object and raises created.

work.desc: Drops created back to false on the next frame.

onClientEndMission.desc: End-of-mission hook: cleans up the objects created by the node.

destroy.desc: Called when the node is destroyed: cleans up the created objects.
